patch_description: Rebuild the solver around an epigraph SLSQP formulation (variables = coordinates + squared-min-distance s, constraints d²ᵢⱼ ≥ s and d²ᵢⱼ ≤ 1) driven by a multi-start loop over both structured candidates (Fibonacci sphere, icosahedron+3, double hexagonal ring with poles, jittered grids) and seeded random starts. After each SLSQP solve, points are rescaled so dmax = 1 and the solve is repeated 3 times per start, directly attacking the dmin/dmax ratio deficit caused by SLSQP terminating with dmax < 1. The best configuration by exact squared ratio (dmin²/dmax²) is returned, rescaled deterministically.
